meta.title: Sports & Recreation
meta.description: Sports and recreation at XLRI Delhi-NCR: a gaming arena for table tennis, pool, carrom and chess; basketball, tennis and badminton courts; an air-conditioned gym; and Xavier’s Hall.

title: Sports & Recreation
intro: The XLRI Delhi campus offers a variety of sports and recreational facilities, ensuring that students have ample opportunities to stay active and unwind.

services.title: Gaming Arena
services.description: The gaming arena is equipped with several indoor game options, including a Table Tennis setup, a Pool Table, Carrom boards, and Chess boards. These facilities provide students with a space to relax and engage in recreational activities that suit a range of interests.

photos.alt: Students around the pool table in the gaming arena

services.title: Sports Facilities
services.description: Outdoor courts for basketball and tennis sit between the campus buildings, a few steps from the hostel.

photos.alt: Students on the outdoor basketball court between the hostel blocks
A game of basketball under the hoop in front of the hostel
The outdoor tennis court at dusk, beside the academic block

services.title: Gymnasium
services.description: The campus houses a fully functional, air-conditioned gymnasium. It is equipped with modern exercise equipment, allowing students to maintain their fitness routines through strength training, cardio exercises, and more.

photos.alt: Weight machines, benches and a dumbbell rack in the gym
A row of treadmills and cross-trainers by the gym windows
A leg-press machine and cable station in the gym

services.title: Xavier’s Hall
services.description: Xavier’s Hall is a large multipurpose venue with a seating capacity of 200-250 people. It serves as a central location for various events, including seminars, workshops, and cultural activities, enhancing the campus's vibrant community life.

photos.alt: Students playing badminton on the court laid out in Xavier’s Hall
